text: child-page originally had no web app manifest, icons or service worker, so Chrome 'install' on Android only created a broken shortcut; installability/offline is tracked as a separate feature issue.

child-page originally required 'no data stored'; features needing persistence (e.g. playtime timer) must explicitly relax that rule for minimal local-only storage and define a parent gate for any parent-facing Settings.
child-page playtime limit design: timer counts only visible activity time, resets automatically each new day, and stores only the limit and time used locally (relaxing the 'no data stored' rule).
child-page review feedback is batched into one issue for polish items, with fixes that depend on an unmerged feature PR (e.g. playtime moon-screen fade) split into their own dependent issue.
child-page Settings (sum gate, limit form, timer reset) lives in js/playtime.js with panes gate-pane/settings-pane in index.html; new parent configuration sections belong behind the same gate.
child-page live app URL is https://bielinskilukasz.github.io/child-page/ (GitHub Pages, owner lowercase); the product name in Polish text is always 'Spokojny Świat Artura' with the diacritic.

child-page: Android's 'Remove animations' setting maps to prefers-reduced-motion in Chrome, and the global style.css rule disables all CSS animations, so CSS-keyframe-driven effects (garden growth) vanish on such devices; JS rAF motion with a capped dt (akwarium 0.05s, cloudTick 0.1s) slows down on low-fps devices.

child-page: a phone-only report of 'animations missing/slow' on Android was caused by the system 'Usuń animacje' (Remove animations) setting being on; ask the reporter to check it before opening a bug.
child-page: the night moon with `.dn-moon` is drawn in js/dzien-i-noc.js (Dzień i Noc), not js/dobranoc.js; users may call it 'Dobranoc' — confirm which activity a moon bug refers to.

child-page deszczyk.js: each cloud has its own rain timer (RAIN_S) and the rainbow counter rainTotal advances at 1 s per second while any cloud rains (RAINBOW_AFTER_S threshold); farma.js barn door X is a separate path outside the .fm-door rect, so it doesn't animate with the door.

child-page Dobranoc (js/dobranoc.js) draws its night moon as a light circle plus a semi-transparent 'cut-out' circle in the sky SVG string; Dzień i Noc has a separate moon (.dn-moon in js/dzien-i-noc.js).

BA: gh issue create via gh-as-agent/gh must run from inside the child-page clone (e.g. cd child-page && python3 -I /tmp/script.py); run from the workspace root or /tmp it fails with 'not a git repository'.

BA: before rewriting a child-page issue that touches already-merged work, check the live code with `gh api repos/BielinskiLukasz/child-page/contents/js/<file>` because the local clone can be stale and plain git pull may be blocked.

child-page Myjnia already contains animals (V V A sequence), so a 'similar but animals-only' request should add a different mechanic (e.g. scrub, rinse, dry stages) rather than a reskin; check css/style.css prefixes (kp- was unused as of 2026-10-26).
BA: for a shared-asset foundation issue, check `gh pr list --search <issue number>` and the issue's comments before answering sequencing questions; the Developer may already have an open PR.

child-page activity ideas that overlap existing ones (excavator vs construction site, build rocket vs Rakieta, dragon vs Latawiec/Balon) are differentiated by mechanic in each issue (precise arm control, cause-and-effect scene, assembly+launch, scrolling free flight).

child-page README: the Activities list item 53 (Zbuduj Rakietę) sits after the 'Menu activities' section, and the Usage statistics paragraph still claims completion exists only for four activities; both are stale doc spots.

child-page pre-1.0 gaps (2026-10-27): no tags/releases, CHANGELOG or LICENSE, only pages.yml as CI (no syntax/link/count checks), and no recorded manual device test checklist (Chrome desktop/Android, Safari iOS).

child-page: gaps vs the first 56 activities (2026-10-27): no colour mixing, cooking/meal making, life cycles, sand/snow marks, torch reveal, symmetry/mirror drawing, pouring/volume, fishing hold-release or daily routine; vehicles, animals and dogs are saturated, and the app is silent so ideas must work without sound.

child-page: the round back button is #back/.back (fixed, 56px, top-left) in the activity view only; Settings (#settings-pane, closed by #settings-close in js/playtime.js) and Statistics (#stats-pane, #stats-back in js/stats-ui.js) used text buttons at the panel bottom until the back-arrow issue.
